create_slab_from_bulk_random: create a Slab object by randomly sampling a slab from a Bulk structure with a given max Miller index
create_slabs_for_specific_millers: create Slab objects for specific Miller indices from a Bulk structure using from_bulk_get_specific_millers
enumerate_all_slabs: enumerate all symmetrically distinct slabs from a bulk structure up to a max Miller index and optionally save to pickle
tag_and_tile_surface_atoms: tag surface atoms as 1 and bulk atoms as 0 then tile the slab to a minimum lateral size
flip_slab_structure: flip a pymatgen Structure object upside down by rotating 180 degrees around the x axis and recentering
